dossiers.catalyst_stack: On 2026-07-22 Alphabet reported Q2 revenue of $119.80B, beating estimates as Google Cloud surged 82% to $24.8B, after a similar Q1 beat on 2026-04-29 that also lifted the quarterly dividend to $0.22. Capacity and power commitments stacked through the year: 2026 capex was raised to $195–$205B, a May 19 Blackstone TPU-cloud JV targeted 500 MW, a September 9 €13B Finland build added a Fortum nuclear PPA, and on 2026-10-06 Google locked 890 MW of PJM nuclear uprates with Constellation. Product and legal catalysts stayed constructive, with Gemini Omni (May 19), Gemini 4 Argon (September 30) and the Gemini Agent (October 8) plus Judge Brinkema’s September 2 rejection of a DOJ AdX divestiture, while Street targets clustered up to $485. The offset is funding and Europe: an ~$80–85B equity raise on 2026-06-01, a record €9B euro bond on 2026-05-05, Waymo’s first $5B term loan on 2026-10-08, the July 2 CJEU uphold of the €4.1B Android fine, and a July 23 €890M DMA penalty.
dossiers.key_assumption: AI/Cloud growth continues to absorb $195–205B of 2026 capex and the June equity raise without a structural FCF disappointment, and U.S. ad-tech remedies remain behavioral rather than a breakup.

dossiers.catalyst_stack: On 2026-04-29 Alphabet beat Q1 with $109.9B revenue, raised the dividend to $0.22 and lifted 2026 capex to $180-190B; on 2026-07-22 Q2 printed $119.8B revenue and a $514B Cloud backlog, pushing capex to $195-205B even as adjusted EPS of $2.85 missed about $2.89. Product momentum followed with Gemini 3.5 Flash at I/O on 2026-05-19 and Pixel 11 on 2026-08-12, while the 2026-06-01 ~$80-85B equity raise, including Berkshire, funded AI capacity at the cost of dilution. The 2026-07-02 EU loss upholding the €4.125B Android fine was offset on 2026-09-02 when Judge Brinkema rejected a forced AdX breakup and ordered six-year behavioral remedies. Berkshire’s 2026-08-14 13F and October PT hikes to as high as $485 add sponsorship, but DMA-style EU AI/search-data demands dated 2026-10-12 and MoffettNathanson’s cut to $370 remain the main overhangs.
dossiers.key_assumption: The $514B Cloud backlog absorbs $195-205B of 2026 AI capex at high utilization, U.S. ad-tech remedies stay behavioral rather than a breakup, and the equity raise does not permanently compress FCF or the multiple.
